## The question

Where and when do U.S. flights go wrong? I wanted to find the worst delays, the cancellation patterns and the busiest periods across airlines and airports.

## Method

```{=html}
<div class="methods"><span>star schema</span><span>PostgreSQL</span><span>window functions</span><span>tidyverse</span><span>ggplot2</span><span>kableExtra</span></div>
```

I designed a dimensional model for U.S. Department of Transportation flight records, wrote SQL to surface anomalies, and charted the results in R.

## Results

```{=html}
<div class="results">
  <div class="res"><b>2,620</b><span>minutes, the longest single delay</span><i>SQL anomaly query</i></div>
  <div class="res"><b>14,488</b><span>cancelled flights analyzed</span><i>cancellation patterns</i></div>
  <div class="res"><b>106,575</b><span>flights on the busiest day</span><i>daily volume</i></div>
</div>
```

Flight volume follows a clear weekday and weekend pattern driven by business travel.
